+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}
+

+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}
+

+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}
+

+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}

+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}

+// The CPU builds the spatial tree once. Its compact representation lets each
+// CUDA thread traverse the same visibility candidates as the original tree.
+struct GpuNode {
+    Vec3 center, halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int first, count;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& indices) {
+    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    GpuNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    flat.first = static_cast<int>(indices.size());
+    flat.count = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (int& child : flat.children) child = -1;
+    for (size_t index : node.triangleIndices) indices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (node.children[i]) nodes[id].children[i] = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, indices);
+    }
+    return id;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBox(const GpuNode& box, Vec3 p1, Vec3 p2) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - box.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > box.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > box.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > box.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > box.halfExtent.y * ad.z + box.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > box.halfExtent.z * ad.x + box.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > box.halfExtent.x * ad.y + box.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ float gpuRayTriangle(Vec3 orig, Vec3 dir, const Triangle& tri) {
+    Vec3 e1 = tri.b - tri.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = tri.c - tri.a;
+    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    float det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    float invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tvec = orig - tri.a;
+    float u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    float v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool gpuRayBlocked(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, const Triangle* triangles,
+                              const GpuNode* nodes, const int* indices,
+                              int source, int target) {
+    Vec3 dir = to - from;
+    float length = dir.norm();
+    if (length < EPSILON) return true;
+    dir = dir / length;
+    // An octree path has at most seven siblings per level. The mesh is
+    // bounded to six subdivisions, so 128 entries cover every possible path.
+    int stack[128];
+    int top = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const GpuNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.count) {
+            for (int k = 0; k < node.count; ++k) {
+                int index = indices[node.first + k];
+                if (index == source || index == target) continue;
+                float distance = gpuRayTriangle(from, dir, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < length - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {
+                int child = node.children[c];
+                if (child >= 0 && gpuRayBox(nodes[child], from, to)) stack[top++] = child;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 gpuRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, float u, float v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) { u = 1.0f - u; v = 1.0f - v; }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u + (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles, const GpuNode* nodes,
+                                 const int* indices, const float* samples,
+                                 float* kij, int* tau, int n,
+                                 size_t firstPair, int pairCount) {
+    for (int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         local < pairCount; local += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        size_t pair = firstPair + local;
+        int i = static_cast<int>(pair / n);
+        int j = static_cast<int>(pair % n);
+        if (i == j) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; tau[pair] = 0; continue; }
+        const Triangle& a = triangles[i];
+        const Triangle& b = triangles[j];
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf((a.center() - b.center()).norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+        if (a._normal.dot(b._normal) > 0.99f) { kij[pair] = 0.0f; continue; }
+        float value = 0.0f;
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const float* sample = samples + (static_cast<size_t>(local) * NUM_RAYS + ray) * 4;
+            Vec3 pI = gpuRandomPoint(a, sample[0], sample[1]);
+            Vec3 pJ = gpuRandomPoint(b, sample[2], sample[3]);
+            if (gpuRayBlocked(pI, pJ, triangles, nodes, indices, i, j)) continue;
+            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
+            float distanceSquared = v.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+            float distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            float cosI = fmaxf(0.0f, v.dot(a._normal) / distance);
+            float cosJ = fmaxf(0.0f, -v.dot(b._normal) / distance);
+            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f)
+                value += (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = value * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(const float* kij, const int* tau,
+                                  const float* areas, const float* radE,
+                                  float* radB, int n, int time, float rho) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(i) * n;
+        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+            if (i == j || time < tau[row + j]) continue;
+            float factor = kij[row + j];
+            if (factor <= 0.0f) continue;
+            float previous = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time - tau[row + j]) * n + j];
+            if (previous > 0.0f) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], 1.0f) * previous;
+        }
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i] = rho * sum + radE[static_cast<size_t>(time) * n + i];
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* radB, float* correlations,
+                                  int n, int timesteps, int source) {
+    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(n) * timesteps;
+    for (size_t item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         item < total; item += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        int i = static_cast<int>(item / timesteps);
+        int delay = static_cast<int>(item % timesteps);
+        float sum = 0.0f;
+        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t)
+            sum += radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - delay) * n + source] *
+                   radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i];
+        correlations[item] = sum;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(const float* correlations, float* distances,
+                               int n, int timesteps) {
+    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n;
+         i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {
+        float best = 0.0f;
+        int bestTime = 0;
+        for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+            float value = correlations[static_cast<size_t>(i) * timesteps + t];
+            if (value > best) { best = value; bestTime = t; }
+        }
+        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * bestTime;
+    }
+}
